tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dpal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi chos skor las: lo rgyus rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bcom ldan 'das dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba de mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs nas: brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal du bzhugs su gsol te: za 'og gi gdan bting: na bza' rdo rje'i gsang lam sku la gsol: gser g.yu'i maṇḍal phul: gser skyogs kyi nang du rgun chang drangs nas zhus pa: slob dpon chen po lags: khyed kyis dus gsum thams cad ma bsgribs sa ler gzigs pas dus bzang ngan ji ltar 'byung zhus pas: slob dpon gyis gsungs pa: rje lags dus kyi tha mar bslebs tsa na: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi rgas ltar 'grib: rmu rgod kyi sems can me ltar 'bar zhing rlung ltar 'tshubs: dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus su: gdon ni klu dang rgyal bsen gnod: nad ni mdze dang smyo 'bog dar: gnyan dang drang srong gi nad kha 'phyo: 'phral du btsog la phugs su ngan pa zhig 'ong gsungs: de'i tshe de dag la phan pa'i thabs tshegs chung la don che ba: bya sla la 'grub mgyogs pa zhig gsung 'tshal zhus pas: gu ru'i zhal nas: kye lha sras nyon cig: bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di: 'dzam gling gru chad kyi ngan shos yin te: bod yul mun pa'i smag rum dang 'dra ba 'di 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rjes 'dul ba las: zhi bas mi thul ba rnams la dpal rta mgrin du sprul nas 'dul ba yin: de la dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus su: sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni: rta mgrin nag po khros pa'i khro bo 'di yin no: 'di shin tu gnyan pas sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang gtor ma la brtson par bya'o: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rta mgrin dbang gi dngos grub brnyes: snang srid 'jig rten dbang du bsdus: lha srin sde brgyad bran du khol: phrin las gang bcol thogs pa med: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru gyur: de phyir dbang chen rta mgrin gyi:

sgrub thabs bye ba sa ya brtsams: la la mchog gi don la dgongs: la la dregs pa gcun la dgongs: la la dgra bgegs 'dul la dgongs: 'di ni dgongs pa gcig tu dril: de dag kun gyi snying po yin: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags dang: drag sngags kun gyi rno so yin: bya sla tshegs chung don chen 'di: rjes 'jug don du zab par gdams: ma spel rin chen gter du sbos: las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: ces gsungs nas mtsho rgyal dang: mnga' bdag rgyal po nyid la gdams pa: de nyid kyis bsam yas mchims phu'i tshogs khang dbus: ka ba mkha' 'gro'i gter mdzod du: rin po che tshe yi sgrub pa dang: phag mo snying tig gi shog dril dang: bstan pa srung ba'i drag sngags 'di gang zag gcig gi cha rkyen du gter du sbas: de nas mnga' bdag sprul pa nyang gis bton te rim par brgyud pa'o: 1$0000250 ༁ྃ: dpal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi sgrub thabs kyi gzhung bzhugs so:1$0000300 rgya gar skad du: shrī ha ya grī ba kā la tsitta sā dha naṃ: bod skad du: dpal rta mgrin nag po thugs kyi sgrub thabs: bcom ldan dpa' bo gcig tu bsgrub pa la phyag 'tshal lo: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs rje'i phrin las gcig bsdus nas: 'gro ba'i don mdzad spyan ras gzigs: gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs ston: zhi bas mi 'dul gdug pa can: tshar gcod rta mgrin nag por bstan: de nyid shin tu khros pa ni: gnod sbyin nag po lcags ral can: dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma dang: gza' klu rgyal bsen gnyen por bstan: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang nyid las: gdug pa 'dul phyir drag po'i sku: rta mgrin nag po zhes kyang bya: yaksha nag po zhes kyang bya: gnod sbyin nag po zhes kyang bya: mgon po nag po zhes kyang bya: ma hā kā la rta gdong can: thugs rje mtshungs med bla ma yin: byin rlabs myur mdzad yi dam yin: bstan pa srung phyir chos skyong yin:

dgra bgegs sgrol phyir las mkhan yin: 'di la rgyas bsdus 'ga' yod kyang: dpa' bo gcig tu bsgrub pa 'di: 'khor gyi rnam grangs nges med phyir: bkra shis rgyud ni 'jam pa yin: gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: rang bzhin shugs kyis 'khor ba'i phyir: shin tu rno la myur ba yin: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: lha srin sde brgyad me ltar 'bar: skye bo rmu rgod rlung ltar 'tshubs: nad mug mtshon gsum chu ltar 'khrugs: glo bur bar gcod thog ltar 'beb: de tshe sngags 'chang sgrub pa po: dpa' bo g.yul ngor zhugs pa 'dra: de la dgos pa rnam pa gnyis: tshur la gang yang mi tshugs pa'i: go cha lta bu'i man ngag dgos: phar la gang yang mi btang ba'i: mtshon cha lta bu'i man ngag dgos: dgos pa gnyis po 'di med na: dpa' bo gcer bu mtshon med 'dra: g.yul ngo bzlog pa shin tu dka': ༈ de la dgos pa dang po ni: go cha lta bu'i man ngag la: khro chu lta bu'i rdzas dang gcig: gnam lcags lta bu'i sngags dang gnyis: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gsum: lus ngag yid gsum srung ba che: dang po rdzas la rnam pa gsum: byug pa bdug pa srung ba gsum: byug pa'i rdzas ni dgu yin te: btsan dug mu zi gu gul gsum: mkhan pa spru ba spyang tsher drug: gla ba shing kun sgog skya dgu: gcig gsum lnga gsum dgu gsum dang: nya stong brgyad gsum dus gnyan la: lus kun bkru zhing byug par bya: gnod byed gang gis nye mi 'gyur: bdug pa'i rdzas la dgu gnyis bstan: btsan dug thang dug bong dug gsum: ra dug re lcag thang phrom drug: gla ba gu gul shing kun dgu: mu zi ldong ros rta bon gsum: 'ba' cha spang spos bshul tshig drug: byil khyi spyang ki'i brun dang dgu: dgu gnyis sbyar ba'i ril bu bsregs: bdug pas gdon rnams bros par 'gyur: srung ba'i rdzas ni dgu gsum bstan: btsan dug bong nga thar nu gsum: ra dug re lcag thang phrom drug:

a sho ba bla spyang tsher dgu: dug sna dgu yi srung ba yin: mi khrag khyi khrag phag khrag gsum: rgya khrag mngal khrag gtsod khrag drug: gri khrag bya rog spyang khrag dgu: khrag sna dgu yi srung ba yin: gla ba gu gul shing kun gsum: tsandan spang spos sha chen drug: mu zi ldong ros rta bon dgu: sman sna dgu yi srung ba yin: dgu gsum sbyar ba'i ril bu bya: g.yag nag rog po'i rwa rtse 'am: gri rkang nang du blugs la 'chang: gnod byed gang gis mthong mi 'gyur: mthong yang tshugs par mi 'gyur ro: ༈ gnyis pa sngags kyis srung ba ni: oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: yaksha nag po nṛ tri hur thuṃ dza: gnod byed mā ra ya: srog la rbad rbad: snying la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: khrag la rbad rbad: sha la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad: klad pa la rbad rbad: yid la rbad rbad: tsitta zung zung: tsitta rmugs rmugs: tsitta phyungs phyungs: tsitta gtubs gtubs: tsitta myog myog: tsitta thuṃ ril: ya ya bhyo bhyo: srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa phyungs phyungs: khaṃ khaṃ: laṃ laṃ: tshal par rbad rbad: dum bur rbud rbud: thuṃ myog baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad sod: raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ha ya grī ba'i 'bru bcu gcig: rta mgrin rtsa ba'i sngags su bshad: yaksha nag po man chad ni: las sngags gnam lcags spu gri yin: nṛ tri dgra dang bgegs kyi srog: hur thuṃ dzaḥni 'gugs pa'i sngags: gnod byed gang yin ming gi them: mā ra ya ni bsad pa 'o: rbad tsho brgyad po bsad pa'i sngags: yang na ral gri'i las su 'dod: tsitta zung nas bhyo yi bar: nyi shu rtsa brgyad rbad pa'i sngags: yang na lcags kyu'i las su 'dod: srog rtsa chod nas rbad sod bar: yig 'bru nyi shu rtsa dgu ni: thun mong bsad pa'i sngags su bstan: dzwa la raṃ gyis sreg par byed: u tsa ta yas bsreg cing gtor: phaṭa kyis thams cad 'joms par byed: 'di yis mi thub gang yang med:

dper na gnam lcags spu gri 'dra: rno ba'i tshad ni me lta bu: myur ba'i tshad ni glog lta bu: rgod pa'i tshad ni thog lta bu: gtum pa'i tshad ni rbab lta bu: dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma dang: nad kyi rigs dang gdon gyi rigs: gnyan rigs lhog pa thab kyi rigs: mdze shu 'brum pa skrang lhog dang: smyo 'bog brgyal nad la sogs pa: gang dang gang du btab pa de: me dang rtswa sbur dpe bzhin du: sreg cing rab tu sreg par byed: rlung dang thal ba ji bzhin du: gtor zhing rab tu gtor bar byed: drag sngags bstan pa mang yod kyang: rno myur ldan pa 'di las med: 'di la rigs ni 'ga' yod kyang: sngags 'grigs tshang ba 'di las med: 'di la bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum: bsnyen pa'i dus su rtsa sngags bzla: sgrub pa'i dus su las sngags bzla: las sbyor las sngags rkyang pa bzla: bsnyen sngags bung bas tshang tshol 'dra: sgrub sngags me dpung 'bar ba 'dra: las sngags ser chen 'beb pa 'dra: sngags kyi gnad la gsum yin te: 'gal me 'khor ba lta bu dang: ba thag 'khrid pa lta bu dang: me sgyogs 'phangs pa lta bu 'o: ༈ gsum pa/ ting 'dzin gsum gyi srung ba ni: rtsa sngags lan gcig bzlas pa yis: skad cig dran rdzogs ting 'dzin gyis: gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor du: bdag nyid khro bo rta mgrin sku: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum mche ba rab tu gtsigs: g.yas pas sgrol byed ral gri yis: dgra bgegs mgo lus dum bur phral: g.yon pas 'dzin byed lcags kyu bsnams: dgra bgegs ma lus srog snying 'dren: zhabs gnyis dgra bgegs ma lus mnan: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur gdengs: rta skad drag po nam mkhar 'tsher: khams gsum ma lus dbang du 'dus: srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon: sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi dang: sku smad stag lpags sham thabs gsol: thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan:

thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas: ba spu'i gseb nas tshwa tshwa 'phro: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: dbu skra gnam lcags ral pa can: ral pa bsig pa'i skra gseb nas: khro chung dpag med phar 'phros pas: dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad de: tshur 'dus khro bo'i gur du gyur: srung zlog bsad pa'i khro bo ni: rim pa gsum gyi tshul du bsam: bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi: thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ni: nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag: gzi brjid ldan pa'i mtha' skor du: rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor bar bsam: 'od zer spro bsdu'i ting 'dzin gyis: snod bcud dngos po thams cad kun: me ri khro bo'i rang bzhin las: gnod byed ming yang med par bsam: sems nyid stong gsal skye med 'di: ye nas rang bzhin lha yi sku: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med la: bskyed bstim rgyas gdab mi 'tshal lo: dran pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa nyid: lta ba gyad kyi lha zhes bya: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin 'di: srung ba kun gyi mchog yin no: gal te dmigs bya bsrung na ni: lus ngag yid gsum sba ba gces: lus ni srung ba'i gur du sba: ngag ni srog snying bar du sba: yid ni thig le'i bar du sba: thun mong ma yin khyad par gnad: sus kyang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro: mthong yang bskal pa'i me chen 'gyur: gal te pha rol rbod gtong sogs: gnod byed bzlog cing bsad pa na: gnam sa lcags bsregs 'khor lo las: me 'bar tshwa tshwa nang nas 'phros: tshur la bsreg cing 'khor bar bsam: bdag gi srung ba'i gur khang las: me 'bar rlung 'tshubs mtshon cha 'phros: phyi la bsreg cing gtor bar bsam: bar du gnod byed byad ma rnams: brlags nas ming yang med par bsam: gal te blo rgya chung ba 'am: lus la gdon chen zhugs pa na: lte bar raṃ yig dmar po bsam: raṃ las me 'bar lus kun bsregs: rang nyid me dpung chen por bsam: raṃ gyi tshwa tshwa 'phros pa las:

me sgra sngags sgra sgrog par bsam: de ltar sgom zhing bzlas pa bya: 'bum phrag bcu gcig thems gyur na: gdon bslang cho 'phrul nges par 'byung: de nas sgrub pa brtsam par bya: dus dang gza' skar bzang po la: dben pa'i gnas su maṇḍal ni: gru gsum khrag dang sol bas byug: dbus su dpal gtor zur gsum bsham: sha khrag dmar tshogs du mas brgyan: khro zangs lcags kyi snod du bsham: bya rgod mda' dang mthing nag dar: tsandan ral gri khru gang dang: seng ldeng phur bu mtho gang ba: mthing shog dag la bzang drug dang: btsan dug gu gul gri khrag gis: sku dang sngags dang 'khor lo bris: sku gsung thugs kyi rten du bzung: de la rten 'brel bskyed bstim bya: thugs dam bskang zhing bzlas pa bya: mchod gtor 'bul nas phrin las bcol: 'grub rtags rab 'bring tha ma gsum: rab ni lha zhal mthong ba dang: rta mgo 'tsher dang rta skad 'don: rang gis rta skad 'byin pa dang: mi nag lcags kyi ral pa can: rta nag 'tsher zhing dngos su 'ong: 'bring ni nyams dang snang ba la: tha ma rmi lam dag tu 'byung: gnas khang rten rdzas gtor ma las: me 'bar 'od 'phro dud pa 'thul: tsheg sgra cho 'phrul chen po 'byung: rmi lam rtags kyi mtshan ma ni: rdzong chen brtsigs dang go khrab gyon: 'khor gsum btags dang mtshon cha brdar: me chen 'bar dang rlung chen 'tshubs: rnga chen brdung dang dung chen 'bud: dar chen phyar dang dmag chen dpon: phyogs las rgyal ba'i mtshan nyid yin: mtshon cha mda' gzhu bcag pa dang: brag chen bshig dang rdzong chen phab: pha bong rlog dang g.yag rgod bsad: sha btson bzung dang glo snying ster: dgra las rgyal ba'i mtshan nyid yin: khrag zor gzir dang phur pa bcag: ser ba bzlog dang sprin nag gtor: gsha' rbud chu bzlog glog lce bcad: byad las rgyal ba'i mtshan nyid yin: chu mig mtsho skam sbal sbrul zos: sdom sdig nya lcong lus las thon: lha khang lder so bshig pa dang:

ban bon nag chags byis pa brdungs: byi la ce spyang khyi sbrul bsad: bgegs las rgyal ba'i mtshan nyid yin: mi nag khros dang rta nag bdas: mdze long dme spyang tshur la rgol: mi mthun mtshan ma byung ba na: thugs dam bskang zhing mnga' gsol bya: bdun gsum dag la nges par 'grub: grub nas rdzas rnams rten du bzung: lha bstim srung 'khor lus la 'chang: gtor ma dgra gdon phyogs su bskyal: de dag bsnyen cing sgrub pa ste: dgos pa gnyis kyi dang po ni: go cha lta bu'i man ngag yin: ༈ da ni dgos pa phyi ma'i don: mtshon cha lta bu'i man ngag ni: drag sngags las la sbyar ba ni: mes tshig g.yul 'gyed mda' 'phen pa: khang brdibs yul shor grong rdal sa: gsha' sbud sa zhig dur khrod sa: phung shul drag po'i sa rnams la: pu ri zur gsum mtho gang ba: bang rim dgu pa khong seng bya: 'og tu zur gsum rkang gang pa: kha khyer rdzab dang ldan par byas: gnyis ka'i phyi nang dug chu dang: dur sol dag gis nag por bya: nang ni khrag dang btsag gis byug: gru gsum kha la rtsang gis bskor: pu ri'i kha la thun lam bya: tsher nag phur pa rkang gang la: drag sngags bris pas thun lam bcad: pu ri la sogs ma grub na: mal 'og 'khrul 'khor shes par bya: de nas dgra bgegs byad ma sogs: gang la bya ba'i ling ga yi: srog yig sngags them tshang bar bris: gru gsum nang du gan rkyal gzhug: khyad par bgegs la kha sgyur rdzas: bsad par 'dod na gri khrag gis: lkug par 'dod na phug ron khrag: zha rengs 'dod na khug rta'i khrag: smyo bar 'dod na smyo klad chu: dbye 'dod bya rog 'ug pa'i khrag: pho gdon rgyal po khyi dkar khrag: mo gdon rgyal mo khyi nag khrag: gza' la gza' ra rog po'i khrag: klu la glang dmar sbal sbrul khrag: btsan la sha khyi dmar po'i khrag: bdud la g.yag nag rog po'i khrag: gshin rje gri rgod khrag gis bris: the'u rang ra kham khrag gis bris: chung sri byi la'i khrag gis bris:

drag po'i thun rdzas sna dgu ni: yung dkar yung nag ram rgod dang: ke tshe shang tshe thang phrom gsum: zangs phye lcags phye rdo phye rnams: drag sngags ngar blud thun gyis brab: bdag nyid zhe sdang drag po'i shugs: rta mgrin khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis: sku las 'phros pa'i khro chung tshogs: tho ba lcags kyu thogs pa spros: lhas byin snying nas lcags kyus bzung: tho bas klad nas bcom par brdungs: rang dbang med par bkug cing bstims: bdug pa'i rdzas kyis lha dang phye: de nas mdun gyi gru gsum de: lcags bsregs khang pa sgo med bsam: dmigs bya dngos su tshud par bsam: steng gi pu ri nag po de: gnam lcags ri rab bang rim la: lha srin sde brgyad dmag tshogs bsam: pu ri'i kha yi phur pa de: khro bo nag po 'jigs su rung: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral pa can: lag na ral gri lcags kyu thogs: lte ba man chad sku smad ni: gnam lcags phur pa zur gsum pa: gang la byed kyi snying la gzir: khro bos rnam shes gzir bar bsam: zur gsum phur pa'i dbal so las: gdug pa'i mtshon gyi char phab nas: phung po dum bur gtubs par bsam: khyad par kho yi snying nang du: ngan sems gdug pa'i rnam smin de: lcags bsregs 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa: drag sngags dang bcas 'khor ba yis: snying khrag gtor zhing snying rtsa bcad: rnam shes mar me bsad par bsam: dregs pa sde brgyad dmag tshogs kyis: sha zos khrag 'thungs rus pa brlags: rdul phran tsam yang med par bsam: drag sngags gzir zhing thun gyis brab: de dag dgra bgegs spyi yi las: go rim bzhin du shes par bya: ༈ da ni khyad par las bstan pa: byad ma bsad pa'i las byed na: mi 'gyur rdzas gcig khong du btang: lha mi gnyis kyi mant+ra ni: steng 'og gnyis su shes par bya: lag tu phur pa re re bskur: sngo dmar tshon gyis byad du bcug: byad thag gnyan po nyid la gtad: lha dang bcas pa dgug cing bstim:

khyad par sprul pa'i khro chung tshogs: tho bas srung ba'i gur khang bcom: mi mthun rdzas kyi byug pa yis: sngags kyi nus pa bshig par bsam: steng gi khro bo'i phur pa yis: kho yi lha srung spyi bo nas: drag tu gzir bas ma bzod de: len rtsa byad ma rang la bzlog: rig sngags bdag po rang nyid kyi: phur pa 'dril zhing gdab pa yis: kho rang lha srung snying gar phog: lhas byin shin tu khros pa yis: slar yang phur pa bsgril zhing btab: srog rtsa bral zhing rnam shes bsad: rang gshed rang la phog par bsam: khyad par kho yi rnam shes las: gdug pa'i dug sbrul dkar nag gnyis: spyi bo bshang lam gnyis nas zhugs: snying gi mgo mjug gnyis nas 'jus: rnam shes dran 'dzin phung ba dang: snying khrag 'jibs nas bsad par bsam: ngan sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa de: lce steng lcags bsregs 'khor ba yi: sdig pa nag po mgo dgu 'jigs su rung: kho yi dge sdig nyes pa dang: sngags kyi nus pas 'jig par bsam: bsam pa ngan pa'i rnam smin de: gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa: snying gi nang na 'khor ba yis: snying khrag gtor zhing snying rtsa gcod: rnam shes kaṃ kaṃ bsad par bsam: de ni byad ma bsad pa'i las: rang gshed rang la bskor ba'i las: kun dang thun mong ma yin pa: bsad las dug mda' nag po 'di: gang la rgyab kyang shor mi srid: mtshams med lnga bas sdig che bas: phar la ma bstan rang la sdig: sangs rgyas bstan dang rang srog la: dgos pa byung na nyes pa chung: ༈ ser ba phab pa'i las byed na: srung ba'i khrag sna dgu po dang: mdze pho rabs chad yugs sa'i khrag: gzhan yang khrag sna tshogs tshad dang: ri gnyan rdo dang chu gnyan chu: ra thug nag po'i grod par blug: rgyab tu gza' yi kha mig bris: chu mig gnyan po'i sngas su mnan: gza' klu sde brgyad bskyed bstim bya: skabs su drag po'i thun gyis brab: de nas gang sdod yul lha'i sgor: gdug pa'i rdzas kyis bdug pa btang:

bskul pa bya: gtor ma dgra bo dngos su bsam la rta mgrin zhal gru gsum gdangs pa'i nang du 'phang: gtor ma log na bskyar nas 'phang: rjes chog: bzod gsol: yig brgya: me thab kyi ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig pa rang la bsdu: mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab: me thab bsdu: rta bro brdung: bsngo ba smon lam bya: thal ba lam rgya gram la sogs su mnan: shin tu gnyan pas gar thod thod du mi bya'o: 'di mnga' bdag nyang gi gter byon rta mgrin nag po'i chos tshan no// maṅga laṃ// 1$0000250 ༄༅// dpal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300chos sku mgon po tshe dpag med// longs sku mgon po spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku padma 'byung gnas dang*// yi dam khro bo rta mgrin la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// yi dam chos skyong gnyis med pa// dpal chen rta mgrin nag po la// sgrub thabs gzhung nas bstan pa bzhin// ma nor tshul bzhin bshad par bya// 'dir dpal rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs 'di la don rnam pa gsum ste/ klad kyi don dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ mjug gi don no// dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan bstan pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mtshan don rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po mtshan bstan pa ni/ rgya gar skad du zhes pa ste/ rgya gar chos kyi 'byung gnas yin pas khungs btsun par bstan pa'o// shrī ni dpal/ ha ya grī ba rta mgrin/ kā la zhes pa nag po/ tsitta ni thugs/ sā dha naṃ ni sgrub thabs zhes pa'o// mtshan thog mar smos pas brjod bya bde blag tu rtogs shing the tshom mi za ba'o// gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo gcig tu bsgrub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ste/ dgos pa ni brtsam pa mthar phyin pa la sogs pa'o// gsum pa mtshan don rgyas par bshad pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhes pa la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gnyis te/

dgos ched kyi don bshad pa dang*/ nyams su len pa'i tshul bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// zhes sogs te/ de dus de rnams kyi gnyen por dpa' bo gcig tu bsgrub pa 'di bstan pa'o// gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ de la dgos pa rnam pa gnyis// zhes sogs te/ go cha lta bu'i man ngag ni bsnyen cing bsgrub pa yin la/ mtshon cha lta bu'i man ngag ni/ las sbyor yin te 'og nas ston no// go cha lta bu'i man ngag bsnyen sgrub gnyis kyi dang po bsnyen pa la/ khro chu lta bu'i rdzas dang*/ gnam lcags lta bu'i sngags dang*/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin ni sku bskyed rim la zer ba yin te/ de yang sngon du 'gro ba/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa gnyis/ dngos gzhi lhar bsgom pa dang gsum las/ dang po la skyabs yul gsal btab nas skyabs 'gro nyer gcig yan chad dang*/ gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ tshad med bzhi lan gsum bya'o// gsum pa dngos gzhi lhar bsgom pa ni/ rtsa sngags lan gcig brjod pas skad cig gis gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ bdag nyid khro bo rta mgrin du bsgom/ dbu skra'i gseb nas 'phros pa'i khro chung rnams kyis/ dgra bgegs tshar bcad nas tshur 'dus pa las srung zlog bsad pa'i khro bo'i gur khang du bsam/ de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer me dpung lta bu 'phros/ lus phyi nang me dpung gi rang bzhin du 'bar bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs nas/ me lce ba spu'i gseb nas phyir 'phros pas/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten khams sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal dngos por gyur tshad thams cad me ri me dpung du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can mi dang mi ma yin 'gro ba gzugs yod med thams cad khro bo'i rnam par gyur nas gnod byed kyi ming yang med par bsam mo// de ltar bsgom pa la yang mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan dgos te/

rnam pa gsal ba/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa'o// de la rnam pa gsal ba ni/ lha'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs thams cad nag nog dang rab rib ma yin par ras bris dang 'bag sku la lta ba bzhin gsal por ma zin gyi bar du bsgom/ rnam dag dran pa ni/ dngos po gdos bcas su bsgom pa ma yin te/ snang la rang bzhin med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar bsgom/ nga rgyal brtan pa ni/ lha yi rnam pa res 'ga' gsal/ res 'ga' mi gsal ba ma yin te/ spyod lam rnam bzhi la sogs dus nam yang lha'i 'du shes dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// de yang*/ sems nyid skye med stong gsal 'di// zhes sogs gsungs te/ sems nyid stong gsal 'dzin med 'di/ ye gdod ma nas lhar rang chas su snang bas/ de las lhag pa'i ye shes pa med pa'i phyir dgug cing bstim du med do// des na mngon byang lnga dang cho ga gsum gyis bskyed cing*/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes pa dgug pa/ dbang bskur ba la sogs gnyis snang gi mtshan ma 'dir ma bshad pas bya mi dgos so// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin 'di// srung ba kun gyi mchog yin no// zhes pa'i rdo rje'i don ni stong pa nyid yin te/ 'gyur ba med cing 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ lha yi ting nge 'dzin la brten pa de dang 'dra bas/ pha rol gyi gnod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs te srung ba'i mchog tu bshad pa'o// ma sring la sogs mo rigs g.yon du bsgom/ bu dang chung ma mdun du bsgom/ nor rdzas longs spyod rgyab tu bsgom/ de yang rang nyid khro bor gsal ba dang*/ bsrung bya rnams kyang khro bor gsal ba gal che/ bsrung bya rnams kyi mgrin pa nas ngag gi dbang po yi ge āḥ'i rnam pa can rtsa sngags la bstim/ snying ga nas rnam par shes pa'i yi ge nṛ yig gi rnam pa can ye shes sems dpa'i hūm̐ la bstim par bya'o// gal te pha rol rbod gtong sogs// zhes sogs kyis gnam sa gnyis lcags bsregs kyi 'khor lo ga'u kha sbyor ba bzhin du yod pa'i nang du/

dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa rang dbang med par shugs kyis tshud de/ 'khor lo'i me lces tshur sreg cing nang gi srung zlog gi khro bo rnams las me 'bar/ rlung 'tshubs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs phyir 'phros pas gtub cing bsregs te gtor bar bsam mo// gal te blo rgya chung ba'am// zhes sogs kyi don ni/ thugs kar sngags 'khor bskor ba'i ting nge 'dzin las shugs kyis rdzogs pa yin pas/ 'dir ched du mi dgos so// gnyis pa sngags kyis srung ba la don gsum ste/ sngags 'grigs dang*/ sngags kyi don bshad pa dang*/ phan yon bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las tshogs so// dang po bsnyen pa'i dus su/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa'i rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pa 'di/ bung bas tshang tshol ba'i skad ltar/ mtho dman drag zhan ring thung med par khod snyoms pas rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung ltar bzlas pa bya'o// grangs ni/ 'bum phrag bcu gcig thems gyur na// zhes sogs ni/ 'bum phrag bcu gcig gam sum 'gyur bton pas dngos sam yang na rmi lam du gdon slong ba'i rtags sha 'gul tsha tshag sna khrag dngos su 'ong zhing*/ rmi lam du'ang sbal sbrul nya lcong sdom sdig grog sbur la sogs 'bu srin 'jus pa rmis so// gnyis pa sgrub pa'i dus su/ rtsa sngags dang las sngags sbrel ba me dpung 'bar ba ltar rig pa ngar dang ldan pas khong shugs bskyed la drag tu 'ur sgra dang bcas te bzla'o// gsum pa las sbyor gyi sngags ni/ yaksha nag po zhes pa nas u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ yan chad kyi sngags ring de/ char ser 'gugs gsum ma gtogs pa las tshogs spyi sgos gang bstan pa kun 'di kho nas chog /gnod byed zer ba'i mal du dgra bgegs byad ma'i ming gzhug par byas la/ ser chen 'beb pa ltar shin tu mtho zhing drag la myur bar bya'o// gnyis pa sngags don bshad pa ni/ ha ya grī ba'i 'bru bcu gcig

/ces sogs so// gsum pa sngags kyi phan yon bshad pa ni/ 'dis ni mi thub gcig kyang med// ces sogs so// 'di la bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum// zhes sogs kyis bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sngags dang 'don lugs dmigs pa rnams bstan te/ gong du ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs sogs dang sbyar zhing shes par bya'o// gsum pa rdzas kyis srung ba ni/ bdug pa dang*/ byug pa/ srung ba gsum ste/ dang po rdzas la rnam pa gsum// zhes sogs kyis gsal bar bstan to// gzhung don gnyis pa sgrub pa la/ bca' thabs dang 'jug pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas sgrub pa brtsam par bya// zhes pa la sogs te/ dus dang gza' skar bzang po 'dzom par dben pa'i gnas su/ maṇḍal gru gsum pa khrag dang sol ba byug /dbus su khri'u'am mañdzi'i khar khro zangs lcags kyi snod gang rung gi nang du 'bru zan la dpal bshos zur gsum pa shin tu 'gying ba zhig la bshos phran brgyad kyis bskor ba bsham/ khrag gis byugs la bong sha ma gtogs pa sha sna tshogs kyis brgyan/ mda' rgod sgro ma la dar nag la rta mgrin gyi sku bris pa zhig btags gtor ma la btsugs/ tsandan gyi ral gri khru gang ba dang*/ seng ldeng gi phur pa mtho gang ba la sgrub sngags tshang bar bri/ mthing shog la bzang drug dang btsan dug dang*/ gu gul gri khrag mtshal dkar sbyar la/ sku dang sngags dang 'khor lo rnams dpe'u ris ltar bris la/ nus pa can gyis rab gnas legs po byas nas dar nag dang mnyam du btag /gtor ma'i g.yas su ral gri /g.yon du phur pa bzhag /mchod pa rnam pa lnga dang*/ sman raka dang rgyun gtor rnams kyis dkyil 'khor bskor/ gzhan bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma rnams che chung mang nyung 'byor pa dang bstun la byang phyogs sam nub phyogs ngos su bsham/ gzhan yang rten byin rlabs can dang rta mgrin gyi bris sku 'bag sku gang yod rnams bkram/ rnga dang thod pa ltag sprod/

tshil chen spos dkar sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshags byas la sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar du phyi mtshams bcad nas nang mtshams bsdam mo// gnyis pa 'jug pa ni/ phyogs skyong la gtsang gtor 'bul/ bgegs la gtor ma byin te mtshams bcad/ thun mong gi srung 'khor bsgom/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas nas/ sgom bzlas bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar byas la mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ sman raka gtor gsum yang byin gyis brlab cing sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ rten gtor bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ khro mchog dbang gi rgyal pos spyan gyis gzigs/ thugs kyi dgongs pa chags nas bzhugs pa'i rten du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgom pa ni/ rtsa sngags lan gcig brjod pas/ e las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus su sku gsung thugs kyi rten tsakra hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo rta mgrin du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ sha chen dang spos dkar bsreg /rnga dung dang ltag sprod la sogs pa rol mo dang bcas pas/ spyan 'dren bzhugs su gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod 'bul rnams bya/ gtor sngags lan bdun la sogs pa brjod cing 'bul/ bstod pa bya'o// de nas sngags thun la 'jug pa ni/ bdag mdun gnyis kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du ye shes sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' skor du/ rtsa ba'i sngags phreng dmar po g.yas su 'khor te/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng 'od zer me dang bcas pa rang gi zhal nas phar 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu nas thon/ lte ba nas tshur byung*/ rang gi lte ba nas tshur zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de bzhin du sngags kyi phreng ba ba thag khrid pa ltar dmar sga ra ra 'khor ba las/

me dpung tshwa tshwa bcas pa 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing*/ dbang drag gi las 'grub par bsam la/ sgrub pa'i sngags ring bzla/ de nas thun 'jog pa'i dus su yang mchod gtor 'bul zhing bstod bskul bya/ dbang drag gi don la gsol ba 'debs/ mdun bskyed ni lha bskyed pa'i rten tsakra dngos la bstims la/ rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya/ bkra shis brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam bya/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la thun mtshams 'jog go /de ltar nyams su len pa la thun bzhir bcad/ thun 'go thams cad du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste/ bdag mdun gyi rim pa mchod bstod yan chad tshang bar byas la/ dang po snga thun la 'jug pa'i tshe yang skad cig kyang ma yengs par ting nge 'dzin la 'bad par bya'o// rjes thun bzhag pa'i tshe yang mchod gtor 'bul/ bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa bya/ sgrub pa'i tshe ni thun gyi 'go mjug gnyis ka na rgyun gtor 'bul lo// de ltar zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrubs pas/ rtags kyi rim pa ni/ 'grub rtags rab 'bring tha ma gsum// zhes sogs kyis gsal bar gsungs pa ltar 'byung zhing*/ grub nas kyang mchod gtor mang du phul/ rten rdzas rnams mi mngon par bya ba sogs bya'o// de yan chad kyis sgrub pa rdzogs par bstan no// des dgos pa dang po go cha lta bu'i man ngag bstan zin to// da dgos pa phyi ma mtshon cha lta bu'i man ngag drag po sngags kyi las sbyor la/ don rnam pa gnyis bstan te/ dgra bgegs spyi yi las dang*/ khyad par gyi las so// dang po spyi yi las la bca' thabs dang 'jug pa gnyis las/ bca' thabs ni/ me yis tshig pa la sogs pa drag po'i sa sna bsdus la/ pu ri zur gsum mtho gang ba bang rim dgu yod pa/ khong seng can bya ste/ 'og tu gru gsum rkang gang ba kha khyer rdzab dang ldan pa byas/ pu ri gru gsum gnyis ka'i phyi khrag dang dug chu dur sol gyis byugs la nag po bya/

nang khrag dang mtshal gyis byugs la dmar po bya/ gru gsum gyi kha khyer rtsang gis bskor/ pu ri nag po'i kha la thun lam bya/ tsher nag gi phur pa rkang gang pa la drag sngags tshang bar bris la/ phur pa de rta mgrin du bsgom/ byin rlabs rab gnas mnga' gsol byas la/ pu ri'i kha thun lam du btsug go /de nas dgra bgegs la sogs gang la byed pa'i ling ga yang*/ so so'i gzugs ji lta ba bzhin byas la/ byad ma dang dgra la byed na dpral bar rus pa/ snying gar nṛ la ming gis bskor/ spyi bor suṃ/ mgrin par dung dang*/ lte bar raṃ/ 'doms su phaṭaḥ rkang zhabs su yaṃ/ brla la rbad/ dpung pa la chings/ phrag gong g.yas la dzaḥ g.yon la hūm̐/ mkhal zur g.yas par baṃ/ g.yon par hoḥ de rgyab sngags tshang mas bskor/ sngags mgo nang du bstan la dril/ rdzas ni khrag sna rnams gzhung du gsal ba bzhin bya'o// bgegs la byed na ling ga rnams ni 'dre gang yin pa so so'i gzugs bris la/ spyi bor nan/ dpral bar ming*/ snying gar tri la khug dza dzaḥs bskor/ lte bar mā ra ya rbad/ yan lag la chings shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gong ltar bri/ khyad par snying gar tri zhabs su rgyal po la tsa/ gshin rje la ya/ ma mo la ma/ bdud la du/ btsan la ru/ gnod sbyin la sha /gza' la ra/ 'dre spyi la tri kho nas chog /ling ga sngar ltar sngags kyis bskor/ de nas rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas bden bdar mang du byas/ dgra bgegs gang yin pa de bkug nas ling ga la yang yang bstim zhing*/ gru gsum nang du mgo rang la bstan la gan rkyal du bzhag ste/ ling ga nyi shu rtsa gnyis byas la bzhag /las grub nas rtsa gcig sbyin sreg byas la/ gcig so so'i gtad ling bcug snod kyi mgo rus nang du bcug la/ sbyin sreg thal ba dang lhan du gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin/ so so'i gtad 'phang sar mnan/ yungs dkar sogs drag po'i thun rdzas rnams thod pa mtshan ngan nang du blugs la drag sngags phus btab cing thun lam nas mar brabs so// phugs su lha rten bzang po bkod/

drag po'i snod du sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma bsham/ de la snying sna dang mgo la dar sna btsug /de'i mdun du rnam lnga dang sman raka thun gtor rnams bsham/ gnyis pa 'jug pa ni/ phyogs skyong dang gnas po gzhi bdag la gtsang gtor 'bul/ drag po mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod cig /ces sogs bka' bsgo bya/ mgon po la mchod bstod skong bshags mnga' gsol las rim bdun pa ltar byas la/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi mtshams dam po gcad de/ lus kyi mtshams dam du bsdams pas mi dang gdong mi sprad/ ngag gi mtshams dam du bsdams pas gzhan dang gtam mi smra/ yid kyi mtshams dam du bsdams pas skad cig kyang mi g.yeng bar rig pa mdung slong du ting nge 'dzin dang drag sngags la 'bad pa yin/ zhag gcig la thun drug tu bcad pa'i thun 'go rnams na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bdag bskyed dang bcas pa byas la/ de nas rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sku las sprul pa'i khro chung tho ba dang lcags kyu thogs pa mang po spros pas/ dgra bgegs byad ma rnams lcags kyu can gyis snying nas bzung*/ tho ba can gyis klad nas bcom zhing brdung ste rang dbang med par bkug nas gru gsum nang gi ling ga la bstim/ bdug pa'i rdzas kyis lha dang phyes te/ mdun gyi gru gsum de lcags bsregs kyi khang sgrom nag la zab cing sgo med pa zhig gi nang du/ dmigs bya gang yin pa dngos su tshud nas gar yang 'gro dbang med par bsam/ steng gi pu ri nag po de gnam lcags kyi ri rab shin tu 'gyings shing dpa' ba zhig tu gyur pa'i bang rim la/ gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsam/ pu ri kha'i phur pa de khro bo nag po 'jigs su rung ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas sgrol byed ral gri glad la phyar ba/ g.yon pas 'dzin byed kyi lcags kyu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba/

mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum bsgrad cing smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral pa can/ spyi gtsug tu rta dbu ljang zhur rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su 'tsher ba/ thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa/ thod rlon gyi do shal dang*/ zhing lpags kyi stod g.yogs can ba spu'i gseb nas me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ lte ba man chad gnam lcags kyi phur bu zur gsum pa/ gang la byed pa'i snying la gzir nus pa des/ kho'i rnam par shes pa gzir zhing phur pa'i dbal so las mtshon cha'i char phab pas dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i phung po dum bur gtub par bsam/ khyad par kho'i snying gi nang du ngan sems gdug pa'i rnam smin de nyid lcags bsregs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa drag sngags dang bcas pa/ g.yon du 'khor bas snying khrag dmar thor thor gtor zhing srog rtsa rbad rbad bcad/ rnam shes mar me bsad pa ltar nag kem kem song nas/ dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs rnams kyis sha zos khrag 'thung*/ rus pa 'chos pas rdul phran tsam yang med par bsam zhing*/ drag po'i sngags kyis gzir zhing thun gyis brab bo// mal 'og 'khrul 'khor ces pa ni/ pu ri phur pa ma gtogs pa gzhan mchod gtor ling ga bri ba kun sngon dang 'dra ba la/ khyad par ni rang gi grwa mal zhabs su gru gsum gyi zur gcig mdun du bstan par byas la ling ga sngar ltar bcas la bzhag /rang nyid lte ba man chad phur bur bsgom zhing*/ gzhan yang sngags thun ting nge 'dzin rnams gong ltar bya'o// de ltar pu ri dang mal 'og las sbyor gang byed kyang*/ thun 'go thams cad du ting nge 'dzin dang dngos gzhi drag sngags gong ltar la thun mtshams su rgyun gtor 'bul zhing bstod bskul byas la/ mngon spyod kyi las 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs bya/ yi ge brgya pa 'don/ bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam bya/ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag /las sbyor ji ltar thon nas ling ga sbyin sreg bya/

gtor ma dgra phyogs su bskyal/ ling ga thal sol gyi bya ba yang bya/ des dgra bgegs spyi yi las kha tshang bar bstan zin to// gnyis pa khyad par gyi las bstan pa ni/ las bcu gcig yod pa gzhan rnams gzhung du bstan la/ 'dir byad ma bsad pa'i las byed na/ gzhan bca' ka thams cad gong dang 'dra/ bye brag ni bag zan la ming gzugs ji lta ba bzhin byas la de'i khog tu dgra bo'i ling ga dang zag rdzas mchil snabs/ dri ma skra gos dum bu za 'phro rjes sa gang rnyed bcug la/ lag pa g.yas pas se shing gi phur bu bzung du bcug la gru gsum nang du gan rkyal du gzhug /yang bag zan la kho rang byad ma'i lha gang yin pa de yi gzugs shig byas la/ shing se ba'i phur chung gcig bzung bcug la byad ma'i gzugs de'i steng du kha sbubs su bzhag /skud pa sngo dmar gyis byad ma dang lha srung gnyis ka'i rke la btags nas/ yar sne phur bu'i mgul du btags/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa ni/ rang nyid khro bo rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal gyis sprul pa'i khro chung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa sprul nas/ byad ma'i srung 'khor g.yas kyi tho bas bcom/ g.yon gyi lcags kyus byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i snying nas bzung*/ rang dbang med par bkug cing gzugs la bstim/ bdug pa'i rdzas dang*/ khyi ra gnyis kyi spu dang*/ bya rog 'ug pa gnyis kyi shas bdug /steng gi phur pa'i khro bo de shin tu khros nas/ phur pa'i dpal so shin tu rno zhing me 'bar ba des kho yi lha srung gi spyi bo nas drag tu gzir bas ma bzod de/ lan rtsa byad ma rang la ded pas byad mas phur bu 'dril zhing yar khro bo la btab pas kho rang gi lha srung gi snying gar phog /lha srung shin tu khros nas slar la phur pa 'dril zhing byad ma'i snying la btab pas/ srog la gzir zhing rnam shes mar me bzhin du bsad rang gshed rang la phab par bsam/ khyad par kho yi zhe sdang las grub pa'i dug sbrul dmar po gcig spyi bo nas mar zhugs snying gi mgo nas 'jus/

dug sbrul nag po gcig bshang lam nas yar zhugs/ snying gi mjug nas yar 'jus/ rnam shes dang ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa snying khrag thams cad 'jibs nas bsad par bsam/ ngan sngags bzlas pa'i nus pa de/ kho'i lce'i steng du lcags bsregs kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa zhig gis/ ngag gi dbang po dang sngags kyi nus pa thams cad 'jibs par bsam/ bsam pa ngan pa'i rnam smin de gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa zhig snying gi nang du g.yon skor du sga ra ra 'khor bas/ snying khrag gtor zhing rnam shes nag kam kam bsad par bsam mo// de ni byad ma bsad pa'i las zhes sogs gsungs te/ shin tu rno zhing nyes pa che bas gar thod thod du mi bya/ rkun nor ltar gsang zhing sba bar bya'o// de nas man ngag spyi'i chings bstan pa ni/ de ltar las sbyor gang byed kyang*// zhes sogs te gdams ngag dag gam mi dag snyam pa'i the tshom yid gnyis spangs la/ 'di bdag gi lha dang chos skyong gi skal pa yin pas srog la thug kyang mi spang snyam pa'i nges shes bskyed la/ spro ba drag pos brtson 'grus dang ldan pas bsgrubs na 'grub thag nye bas mi 'grub mi srid de/ o rgyan padma'i zhal nas/ brtson 'grus ldan pa'i mis brag la chu thon// nges shes skyes na 'dre yang lha ru 'gyur// ces gsungs so// spyi don gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum ste/ mdzad pa po/ sgrub thabs dngos/ mi spel ba'i dam bca'o// dang po ni/ bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis mchog dang thun mong la dgongs nas padma dbang chen gyi sgrub thabs bstan pa'i tshul ni/ de phyir dbang chen rta mgrin gyi/ zhes sogs te/ rta mgrin sgrub thabs bsam yas mdzad pa'i nang nas khyad par du zab pa/ yi dam chos skyong gnyis med/ mchog dang thun mong gnyis med/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis med/ tshig nyung la don 'dus pa 'di gsungs so// gsum pa ni/

de nas slob dpon gyis mtsho rgyal dang rgyal po gnyis la/ da lta ma spel gter du sbos// zhes gsungs pa bzhin gter du sbas nas/ las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog /ces smon lam btab pas/ phyis rgyal po'i skye mtha' mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'o// dpal grub pa'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi don gsal bar phyes pa 'di mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis mdzad pa yin ces rje btsun rgyal mtshan gyis gsungs shing*/ 'di yi ma dpe la gzhung dkyus su shor ba 'ga' zhig dang sgrub thabs dang 'dres pa dang*/ gter kha gzhan gyi lugs 'dir bsres pa la sogs pa dus ring ba'i dbang gis tshig don 'chugs pa cung zad dang bcas pa'i 'grel pa yi ge shin tu nyog pa gcig snang ba de'i steng na 'chad nyan mdzad cing 'dug pa las/ de dag la dbri bsnan dang zhu dag legs par byas nas yi ge cung zad nyung du btang nas shākya'i btsun pa wā gind+ra sthi ras rang lo nyer lnga lon pa sa pho spre'u'i lo'i dbyar mdo khams stod kyi sa cha gying thang du bris bshus dag par bgyis pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: dpal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral gyi rjes gnang dang srog dbang skur ba'i tshul bzhugs so:1$0000300 ༁ྃ: bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mgrin nag po'i sgo nas byin rlabs kyis slob ma rjes su 'dzin par 'dod na: 'di'i cho ga'i rim pa bla ma'i phyag len bzhin: rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum gang spro skabs dang bstun: de nas slob ma rnams bum pa'i chus khrus byas: bgegs bskrad la srung 'khor bsgom: de nas yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed 'bogs pa rnams sngon du song nas: dngos gzhi thog mar rjes gnang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas: gsol ba gdab pa ni: dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i:

rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs kyis: sku yi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: gsung gi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: thugs kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: yon tan sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: phrin las sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab: de nas slob ma rnams rta mgrin du bskyed la dam tshig sems dpar bsgom: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la rta mgrin ye shes sems dpar bsgom: de nas ye shes sems dpa'i sku'i cha thams cad nas: khro chung gi tshogs sku chung la yan lag rags pa nas 'bras tsam dpag tu med pa byon nas phyir 'phros pas: phyi'i bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: khro chung thams cad 'dus slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum thams cad khro chung gis gang nas: nang gi bar du gcod pa'i nang gdon sdig sgrib bsregs par bsam la rtsa sngags sham bu dang bcas pa lan gsum brjod cing rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o: de ni sku'i byin rlabs kyi rjes su gnang ba'o: yang ye shes sems dpa'i zhal nas sngags phreng dmar po me dpung gi rang bzhin: tshwa tshwa dmar si li li byung nas slob ma'i khar zhugs: lus thams cad dmar me re re gang nas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs par bsam la: sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du bcug: de ni sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba'o: de nas spyi bo'i ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas tshangs bug tu mar byon nas: snying gar thim pas dpal khro bo rta mgrin gyi thugs kyi ye shes dang: slob ma'i rnam shes gnyis dbyer med du chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa ltar du gyur par bsam la: dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o: de ni thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'o: de nas slob ma rta mgrin du gsal ba'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po:

mgrin par padma'i steng du āḥdamar po: thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du dmigs la: gnas gsum bdud rtsi'i thig le byas la: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes brjod: de ni yon tan gyi rjes su gnang ba'o: de nas gtor ma lag tu gtad la: rdo rje'i slob ma khyod la dpal rta mgrin nag po'i srog dbang bskur pa yin pas: rta mgrin nag po yi dam gyi lhar zungs shig: chongs shig: sgoms shig: sgrubs shig: thon cig: lha ma srin sde brgyad dang dregs pa can dbang du sdus shig: dam la thogs shig: dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar chod cig: ces brjod: de ni phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'o: de nas rjes kyi bya ba gtang rag gi yon du maṇḍal 'bul: lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i bran du khas blang ngo: 'di rta mgrin nag po'i srog dbang zhes bya ste: nyams su len pa'i slob ma re re ma gtogs gzhan la mi sbyin: rang la chad pa 'ong bas bka' rgya shin tu bsdam pa gal che'o: gal te nad pa la sogs pa'i bar chad bsal bar 'dod na: byin rlabs khro bo char 'beb kyi rjes su gnang ba ni: sku'i rjes gnang skabs su: dang po sku'i khro chung dkar po: de nas gsung gi khro chung dmar po: de nas thugs kyi khro chung nag po: de nas yon tan gyi khro chung ser po: de nas phrin las kyi khro chung ljang gu: de rnams rim pa ltar spro bsdu bya zhing sngags dang rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o: 'di ni shin tu rno la byin rlabs che bas bar chod sel ba la lhag par shis so: de nas gtor ma la dgra bgegs dgug gzhug byas la bstims: sman raka kyis bran: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlabs la: mdun du khro bo 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis dmigs la gtor ma 'bul: bskul byas la gnod byed kyi phyogs su bskyal:

rjes su yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang: bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas gdab bo: ༈ bcom ldan 'das padma dbang chen la phyag 'tshal lo: rta mgrin nag po'i srog dbang bskur bar 'dod pas: maṇḍal gru gsum nag por byug pa'i steng du hūm̐ gcig bri: de'i steng du khri'u'am mañdzi'i khar: khro zangs lcags kyi snod nang du dpal bshos sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham: mda' dar la rta mgrin gyi sku dang srog 'khor btags la btsugs: de'i g.yas su ral gri: g.yon du phur pa: mdun du lcags kyu: dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du nyer spyod lnga dang sman rag gtor gsum gyis bskor: de nas slob ma khrus byas la nang du gzhug: phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag la gtsang gtor phul te bka' bsgo: bgegs la gtor ma byin: mtshams bcad: srung 'khor bsgom: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya: bdag bskyed bsgom: bzlas pa bya: mchod pa sman raka gtor gsum byin gyis brlab: dpal gtor la mdun bskyed bsgom gnas gsum byin gyis brlab: spyan 'dren mchod bstod byas la: ting 'dzin dang bzlas pa'i thun bya: de nas maṇḍal phul te dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i gsol ba gdab pa ni: he ru ka dang gnyis med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: bcug nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: zhes lan gsum brjod: de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku: byang chub sems la skyabs su mchi: dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs nas: bstan dang 'gro ba'i don slad du: bsnyen cing bsgrub par dam bca' 'o: de nas slob ma'i gnas gsum du bdud rtsi srin lag gis reg cing: spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa: mgrin par padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa: snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa: zhes slob ma la bsgom du gzhug: skabs 'dir yan lag bdun pa'i tshogs gsag pa ni:

mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs sprin gtibs pa ltar bsam la: bla ma rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sdig pa'i tshogs rnams mthol lo bshags: rang gzhan dge la rjes yi rang: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: dge ba 'gro kun yongs la bsngo: zhes lan gsum brjod: de nas sdom pa bzung ba ni: bla ma dpal chen he ru ka: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: sngon tshe rgyal bas thugs bskyed ltar: byang chub sems ni bzung bar bgyi: sangs rgyas rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: rdo rje'i rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: rin chen rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: padma'i rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: las kyi rigs mchog dam tshig kyang: bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi: zhes lan gsum brjod: de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni: dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: bdag ni dpal chen dbang gi sgor zhugs kyis: sku yi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol: zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas: mdun bskyed kyi khro bo'i sku gsung thugs las: khro bo dkar dmar mthing gsum nas 'bras tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin byung nas: slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga nas thim pas: lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad sang sang dag par bsam zhing: dar nag gi sku'i dbang bskur la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: dar nag sku yi dbang bskur bas: snang srid zil gyis non par shog: rtsa sngags dang: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ:

zhes pas sku'i dbang thob: gsol btab sngar bzhin: yang mdun bskyed kyi zhal nas sngags phreng ā li kā li dang bcas pa dmar na ra ra byung ba: slob ma'i mgrin par thim pas lus thams cad sngags kyis dmar ltem me gang nas: drag sngags la nus pa thon par bsam zhing: lcags kyus dbang bskur la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: lcags kyu gsung gi dbang bskur bas: log 'dren dbang du sdud par shog: rtsa sngags dang: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: ces pas gsung gi dbang bskur ba thob: gsol ba btab: yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gzi brjid dang ldan pa: 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byung nas: slob ma'i snying gar thim pas lus thams cad hūm̐ sngon pos gang nas: rtogs pa 'char zhing nus pa dang ldan par bsam la phur pa'i dbang bskur: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: phur pa thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: dregs pa las la 'khol bar shog: rtsa sngags dang: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes thugs kyi dbang bskur ba thob: gsol ba btab: yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha la myur ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang ste: ma mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dregs pa pho mo rnams kyi srog snying mthu nus thams cad dbang du bsdus nas: slar 'dus te khro bo'i thugs kar thim pas: khro bo'i thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i 'od kyi thig le sngon po gcig tu gyur: de slob ma'i lte bar thim pas rta mgrin gyi srog dbang thob par bsam: tsakra'i dbang bskur la: hūm̐: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpal chen khro bo rta mgrin gyi: yon tan tsakra'i dbang bskur bas: khro bo'i mthu rtsal drag po'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags dang: tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: zhes pa yon tan no:

dpe la lar/ dam nyams srog dbugs len pa'i phyir: sdig pa nag po'i= sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir: dpal ldan mgon po'i= 'byung po pho mo 'dul ba'i phyir: lcags ral nag po'i= lha min g.yul ngo zlog pa'i phyir: legs ldan nag po'i= bstan pa'i ru dra bsgral ba'i phyir: srung ma nag po'i= drag po'i las la mnga' mdzad phyir: las mkhan nag po'i= tshe dang srog la mnga' mdzad phyir: srog bdud nag po'i= gsod dang gcod la mnga' mdzad phyir: shan pa nag po'i= sha dang khrag la mnga' mdzad phyir: mon pa nag po'i= stong gsum dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i phyir: sprul pa nag po'i= bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: yang sprul nag po'i= gtso bo'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i phyir: bka' nyan pho nya'i= dpal gyi bka' sdod yin pa'i phyir: dregs pa pho mo'i= bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i phyir: lha srin sde brgyad= mchod na dge ba'i grogs mdzad phyir: yul lha zo dor thugs dam bskang: khyed kyi thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: dam tshig nyams chag bskangs gyur cig: chag che nyam nga med par mdzod: sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen: mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdzod: tshe dang longs spyod spel ba dang: 'khor dang bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: snang ba dbang du 'dus pa dang: bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod: lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba dang: phyi nang bar chad zlog tu gsol: byin rlabs mthu rtsal chen po dang: dbang drag phrin las thog ltar phob: dgra la rbad na dgra dpung choms: bgegs la rbad na bgegs dpung thul: gdon la rbad na gdon skung phud: lus gdon nad gdon rtsad nas chod: god 'dre yul 'dre phugs nas phyungs: dam sri 'dre mo tshang nas thon: sa bdag klu gnyan snying nas drongs: rgyal bsen 'byung po spyi nas choms: gza' gdon thams cad rdul du rlogs: byad ma rang gshed rang la phob: nad pa yod na mal nas slongs:

sri 'u yod na tshang nas skyed: shi kha chod la god kha sdoms: god kha chod la nor phyugs skyongs: mi kha sgyur la yams kha zlog: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gsum pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: byams mgon thugs rje phyogs ris mi mnga' yang: sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam mtha' yas kyis: zhi la zhi dang khro la khro bo sogs: gang la gang 'dul de la der ston cing: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa: byams mgon thugs rje can la bzod par gsol: bzod par gsol lo tshangs pa bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: rta mgrin nag po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: chos kyi sku la byams sdang mi mnga' yang: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa: dbang drag stobs kyis tshar gcod rjes bzung mdzad: shin tu khros pa gnod sbyin nag po'i gzugs: gnam lcags ral pas stong khams mun ltar gtibs: chos nyid yangs pas 'jig rten lto bar bcug: snying rje rngams pas 'gro drug thabs kyis 'dren: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'ga' gyur pa: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la bzod par gsol: bzod par gsol lo tshangs pa bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: yaksha nag po gsan cing dgongs su gsol: chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: thugs rje'i dbang gis ma rungs tshar gcod phyir: shin tu mi bzad gnod sbyin gdug pa can: khro gtum srin po'i cha lugs srog la rngams: rab 'jigs drag po'i 'khor tshogs las la 'gyed: bstan pa bsrung phyir bka' yi bya ra mdzad: dkar po'i phyogs skyong nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa: dbang chen dregs pa 'dul la bzod par gsol: bzod par gsol lo tshangs par bstsal du gsol:

hūm̐: gsang sngags gnyan po'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor pa: shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur pas: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol= thugs kyi dam tshig= rtsa ba'i dam tshig= yan lag dam tshig= phrin las dam tshig= sdom pa spyi dang 'gal ba mthol= bka' lung dbang dang mi ldan mthol= dam tshig snod dang mi ldan mthol= man ngag bcud dang mi ldan= nyams len gdings dang mi ldan= yi dam blang dor byas pa mthol= bsnyen sgrub bar chad byas pa= bskyed rim ting 'dzin ma gsal= rdzogs rim dgongs pa ma rdzogs= bzlas brjod snying po ma dag= phrin las gzhung bzhin ma bsrang= mchod pa lo zlar 'das pa= tshogs dang gtor ma chag pa= dus dang dus las 'das pa mthol lo bshags: dus min las la sbyar ba= mthol lo bshags so bla ma yi dam lha: gnong ngo 'gyod do dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bzod par gsol lo srung ma dam tshig can: tshangs par stsol cig badzra sa ma ya: a a: bzhi pa mnga' gsol ni 'di skad do: hūm̐: dpal ldan ma hā kā la rta gdong zhal: khyed la mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo: bla mar mnga' gsol tshad med thugs rje can: khyed la mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo: yi dam mnga' gsol byams mgon spyan ras gzigs: khyed la mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo: dpa' bor mnga' gsol rta mgrin dbang gi lha: khyed la mchod cing bstod de mnga' gsol lo: khro bor mnga' gsol gnam lcags ral pa can: khyed la mchod cing= mgon por mnga' gsol dpal ldan nag po che: khyed la mchod cing= chos skyong mnga' gsol ma hā kā la che: khyed la mchod cing= bstan srung mnga' gsol lha chen tshogs kyi bdag: khyed la mchod cing= las mkhan mnga' gsol yaksha mthu bo che: khyed la mchod cing= shan par mnga' gsol gnod sbyin srog la rngams: khyed la mchod cing= tshar gcod mnga' gsol phyag g.yas ral gri bsnams: khyed la mchod cing= rjes bzung mnga' gsol phyag g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin:

khyed la mchod cing= zil gnon mnga' gsol dar nag ber chen gsol: khyed la mchod cing= dbang drag mnga' gsol spyi gtsug rta skad 'tsher: khyed la mchod cing= yon tan mnga' gsol dpal gyi cha lugs can: khyed la mchod cing= phrin las mnga' gsol srid gsum gdug pa 'dul: khyed la mchod cing= lha dbang mnga' gsol lha rnams zil gyis gnon: khyed la mchod cing= klu dbang mnga' gsol klu rnams zas su za: khyed la mchod cing= stobs ldan mnga' gsol dregs pa las la bskul: khyed la mchod cing= ye shes mnga' gsol me dpung dbus na bzhugs: khyed la mchod cing= 'jig rten mnga' gsol sde brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: khyed la mchod cing= dam can mnga' gsol sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung: khyed la mchod cing= dgra blar mnga' gsol dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod: khyed la mchod cing= rnal 'byor bdag gis khyed la mnga' gsol bas: khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes nas: yon tan phrin las stobs kyi rtsal phyungs la: bstan pa'i dgra bgegs ma rungs rdul du rlogs: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas bsrung du gsol: mi mthun rkyen zlog bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: lnga pa zlog pa ni: kye: yang cig thugs rje chen po snyan gson dang: rta mgrin nag po snyan gson dang: nag po chen po snyan gson dang: yaksha nag po snyan gson dang: 'khor gyi dregs pa snyan gson dang: pho nya las mkhan snyan gson dang: khyod ni sngon gyi thugs dam can: bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po: bdag ni khyed la mchod cing gsol: khyed kyi phrin las dus la babs: dus la bab bo dam tshig can: khyed la zlog sgyur phrin las bcol: zlog sgyur phrin las bcol ba ni: sngon tshe zlog pa gang nas byung: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten du: ru dra sde gsum dar ba'i tshe: dpal chen rigs gsum mgon po yis: drag po dpal gyi gtor chen bshams: gsang sngags mthu yi rnga chen brdungs:

rig sngags thun gyi zor chen 'dril: ru dra sde gsum gtan nas brlags: de nas zlog pa gar srid na: sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas su: lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe: lha dbang rgyal po stobs chen gyis: drag po dpal gyi gtor chen bshams: gsang sngags mthu yi rnga chen brdungs: rig sngags thun gyi zor chen 'dril: lha min g.yul ngo bzlogs par mdzad: de nas zlog pa gar srid na: rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: mu stegs dmag tshogs rgol ba'i tshe: slob dpon shākya seṅge yis: drag po dpal gyi gtor chen bshams: gsang sngags mthu yi rnga chen brdungs: rig sngags thun gyi zor chen 'dril: mu stegs dmag tshogs pham par mdzad: sngon byung srid pa de bzhin du: da lta sngags 'chang sgrub pa pos: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi: phyi nang bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir: drag po dpal gyi gtor chen bshams: gsang sngags mthu yi rnga chen rdung: rig sngags thun gyi zor chen 'dril: mi mthun bar chad zlog gyur cig: bhyo: drag po dpal gyi gtor chen 'di: gsang sngags 'dus pa'i byin rlabs yin: rig sngags 'dus pa'i mtshon cha yin: khro bo 'dus pa'i mthu rtsal yin: khro mo 'dus pa'i drag rtsal yin: pho nya 'dus pa'i las mkhan yin: sde brgyad 'dus pa'i dmod mo yin: 'di yis mi zlog gang yang med: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas la: chag che nyam nga mchis pa yang: zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: sngon gyi las las gyur pa yang: zlog go dmar chen gtor mas zlog: 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa yang: zlog go= yas kyi bdud kha g.yos pa yang: zlog go= mas kyi sri kha ldangs pa yang= zlog go= pha rol rbod gtong btang ba yang: zlog go= tshe la bar du gcod pa yang= zlog go= srog la hur thum 'byung ba yang: zlog go= lus kyi 'byung ba 'khrugs pa yang: zlog go= sems la sdug bsngal 'beb pa yang: zlog go= dus min 'chi ba thams cad kyang:

zlog go= he ru ka yi drag sngags kyang: zlog go= khro tshogs yab kyi drag sngags kyang: zlog go= ma tshogs yum gyi drag sngags kyang: zlog go= 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= pho nya las kyi drag sngags kyang: zlog go= mgon pos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= ma mos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= gshin rjes dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= gnod sbyin dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= pho rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= mo rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= lha rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= klu rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= gnyan rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= gza' rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= bdud rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= btsan rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= ru dras dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= ma yams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= 'gong pos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= rgyal pos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= bsen mos dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= the'u rang dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= sa bdag dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= mu stegs dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= bgegs rnams dmod pa'i drag sngags kyang: zlog go= lha yis dal zor 'phen pa yang: zlog go= lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa yang: zlog go= gza' rgod king kang 'bebs pa yang: zlog go= gshin rjes 'khor lo bskor ba yang: zlog go= ma mos khrag nad gtong ba yang: zlog go= 'chi bdag khram la btab pa yang: zlog go= bdud kyis zhags pa 'phen pa yang: zlog go= btsan gyis jag sna rgyug pa yang: zlog go= rgyal pos smyo 'bog gtong ba yang: zlog go= 'byung pos bar chad byed pa yang: zlog go= gnod sbyin za kha ston pa yang: zlog go= sa bdag khram la btab pa yang:

zlog go= klu yis gtad khram bcug pa yang: zlog go= the'u rang sris la rku ba yang: zlog go= mu stegs ngan sngags byed pa yang: zlog go= bandes rig sngags byed pa yang: zlog go= bon pos mthu sgrub byed pa yang: zlog go= skye bos mda' zor 'phen pa yang: zlog go= bud med dug zor bshams pa yang: zlog go= bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu yang: zlog go= nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi yang: zlog go= keg rigs sum brgya drug cu yang: zlog go= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi yang: zlog go= ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu yang: zlog go= glo bur nyis khri chig stong yang: zlog go= dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad kyang: zlog go= mo ltas mtshan ma ngan pa yang: zlog go= pha tshan nang gi rgyab 'dre yang: zlog go= ma tshan nang gi byur 'dre yang: zlog go= dar tshan nang gi stong 'dre yang: zlog go= dar sri gzhon sri chung sri yang: zlog go= brgya yi mi kha zug pa yang: zlog go= stong gi bra mchu zug pa yang: zlog go= ma nyes kha yog ngan pa yang: zlog go= mi yi na tsha thams cad kyang: zlog go= nor gyi god ka thams cad kyang: zlog go= zhing gi btsa' sad ser gsum yang: zlog go= than ltas ngan pa thams cad kyang: zlog go= zlog sgyur phrin las bcol pa bzhin: sgyur ro ltas ngan tsher rtsub sgyur: zlog pa'i rgyal pos zlog tu gsol: sgyur ba'i rgyal pos sgyur du gsol: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: drug pa dgra chos bya ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni thugs rje chen po'i sku: nga ni rta mgrin dbang gi lha: nga ni khro bo kun gyi rje: nga ni mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso: nga ni snang srid kun gyi bdag: khams gsum srid gsum nga yi zas: che ba'i lha rnams nga yi 'khor: chung ba'i lha rnams nga yi bran: mthu chen stobs ldan zil gyis gnon: nga yi thugs kyi sprul pa ste: thugs rje chen po khros pa'i sku:

ma hā kā la rta gdong zhal: yaksha nag po mthu bo che: las mkhan gnam lcags ral pa can: rab 'jigs gnod sbyin nag po rngams: gting nas khros shing chas tsa na: stong gsum kun kyang shigs se shig: gnam sa kun kyang 'u ru ru: ri rab kun kyang sga ra ra: rgya mtsho kun kyang me re re: nyi zla gza' skar cha la la: rigs drug sems can nyi li li: lha srin sde brgyad sha ra ra: mkha' la 'brug sgra di ri ri: bar snang glog dmar khyugs se khyug: gnam lcags ser chen khra la la: rlung nag 'tshubs ma kyi li li: bskal pa'i me 'bar lams se lam: mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa spungs se spung: bskul lo stobs ldan nag po che: rbad do dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs: chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chos: stobs ldan nag po dgra la chos: yaksha nag po dgra la chos: gnod sbyin nag po dgra la= ru dra nag po dgra la= srog bdud nag po= las mkhan nag po= shan pa nag po= mon pa nag po= lha dmag 'bum dang dgra la chos: klu dmag 'bum dang dgra la= gnyan dmag 'bum dang= bdud dmag 'bum dang= btsan dmag 'bum dang= mi nag 'bum dang= bya nag 'bum dang= khyi nag 'bum dang= gcan gzan 'bum dang= dgra bo'i mi dpa' rta mgyogs kyi: dpung pa chogs la rgyus pa chings: go cha shus la rno mtshon phrogs: mi rta phyes la nang tshan dkrugs: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: dgra bo'i bu rta cham la phob: dgra bo'i pho rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bo'i mo rgyud mngal nas skems: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud mtha' nas sdus: dgra bo'i bla ri rmang nas shigs: dgra bo'i bla mtsho gting nas skems: dgra bo'i bla shing rked nas chogs: dgra bo'i sgo nor phyags mas thobs: dgra bo'i yul mkhar rlung la skur: gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis: mnyam por bzhes la med par mdzod: kye: sangs rgyas chos la dgra byung na: srung ma dam can ra mdar ldogs: rem zhig chos skyong mthu rtsal can: chos shig dgra dang bgegs la chos:

mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: ma mo'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dgra la chos: gnod sbyin dmag tshogs dgra la chos: lha yi dmag tshogs dgra la chos: klu yi dmag tshogs dgra la= gnyan gyi dmag tshogs= gza' yi dmag tshogs= bdud kyi dmag tshogs= btsan gyi dmag tshogs= rgyal po'i dmag tshogs= 'gong po'i dmag tshogs= the'u rang dmag tshogs= sa bdag dmag tshogs= yul lha'i dmag tshogs= zo dor dmag tshogs dgra la chos: dmag tshogs dgra la chas tsa na: btsan po gyon la rnon po thogs: go cha gyon la mtshon cha bdor: mgyogs pa zhon la rings par rgyugs: dpa' ba'i go gyon lhubs se lhub: mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug springs se spring: shan pas mtshon thogs zangs se zang: ki bso cha sgra ti ri ri: dar nag ru mtshon pu ru ru: rlung nag 'tshubs ma kyi li li: nad kyi na bun thibs se thib: yams kyi rlangs pa phyu ru ru: khrag gi ser ba hri li li: dug gi khu 'phang sha ra ra: mtshon gyi char pa si li li: sngags kyi 'brug sgra di ri ri: thun gyi glog dmar khyugs se khyug: zor gyi thog mda' chems se chem: zor mda' dgra bo'i snying la rgyob: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: kye: las ngan sdig can dgra bo 'dis: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig: theg pa che la skur pa btab: dge 'dun 'dus pa'i dkor la phrogs: dge ba bcu po rgyab tu bskyur: mi dge bcu po dang du blangs: dam can yongs la do yang bsdos: sngags 'chang bdag la 'gras su btsal: sgrub pa po la lha med zer: sangs rgyas chos la bden med zer: srung ma khyod la mthu med zer: bdag gis ma nyes kho yis nyes: chags pa med par bu lon bdas: byas pa med par srog la rgol: de bas bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur: zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig po che: sdig can myur du ma bsgral na: dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa bshig: srung ma dam tshig nyams par 'gyur: de bas srung ma dam ma g.yel:

de bas srung ma mthu ma chung: de bas srung ma rtsal ma zhan: dus la bab bo dam tshig can: gtad do gnyer ro dgra dang bgegs: khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus: sod cig thul cig med par mdzod: bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog: gnam gyi 'ju thag chod la shog: sa yi rten phur phud la shog: tshe yi 'du byed bsdus la shog: srog gi 'phar thag chod la shog: sems kyi mar me sod la shog: dgra bo las ngan sdig can 'di: lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang phyes: mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud dang sprod: las kyi gshin rje'i shan pa yis: pho rgyud rnams kyis sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyis khrag la thungs: bya gcan rnams kyis nang khrol zo: khong khrag kha nas skyug tu chugs: nang dbugs phyi ru 'dren du chugs: phung po sa la 'gyel du chugs: 'o dod gnam du 'bod du chugs: yan lag brang la brdung du chugs: yar sha yar la dgra sha zo: mar sha mar la dgra khrag thungs: phar sha tshur la dgra rus mur: til 'bru tsam yang med par mdzod: mā ra ya yi dus la bab: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod:

bdun pa rta bro ni: hūm̐: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung po la: dpa' bo chen pos bro brdungs pas: phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams gang nas: khro bo'i tshogs dang khro mo'i tshogs: ma sring tshogs dang pho nya'i tshogs: bro la gshegs so chems se chem: hūm̐: nga ni rta mgrin khros pa'i sku: rta skad lan gsum steng du sgrog: dang pos gzugs med khams kun g.yos: gnyis pas gzugs khams dbang du bsdus: gsum pas 'dod khams zil gyis mnan: 'di ni rta mgrin brtul zhugs yin: hūm̐: nga ni rta mgrin khros pa'i sku: rta bro 'khor gsum 'og tu brdung: dang pos sa steng 'jig rten g.yo: gnyis pas sa bla dbang du sdud: gsum pas sa 'og zil gyis gnon: 'di ni rta mgrin mthu rtsal yin: hūm̐: nga ni rta mgrin khros pa'i sku: dug gsum dgra bgegs zhabs su mnan: zhe sdang pho rgyud g.yas su mnan: 'dod chags mo rgyud g.yon du mnan: gti mug rigs rgyud rtsad nas brlag: 'di ni pho nya'i phrin las yin: hūm̐: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: byad ma dam sri gdon gyi tshogs: zhabs kyi 'og tu bsdus nas ni: rta mgrin khros pa'i tshogs kyis brdungs: ye shes ri rab lcid kyis gnon: drag sngags rdo rje'i mtshon gyis gtub: gzi brjid me dpung 'bar bas bsreg: srid pa las kyi rlung gis gtor: ji srid bskal pa ma rdzogs bar: dgra bgegs ldang bar ma gyur cig: sarba bighnān sha trūṃ st+wambha ya nan: dpal rta mgrin nag po'i skong ba mnga' gsol: zlog pa dgra chos gang byed kyang: khro'am lcags gang rung gi snod du: dpal gtor dmar nag zur gsum bsham: sha sna dang snying sna khrag snas brgyan: khyad par zlog pa dang dgra chos byed na: tsher ma dang yungs dkar sgang bu rtsang rnams kyis bskor la btsug: dgra bgegs byad ma'i ling ga byas la btsug: de nas rta mgrin khros pa'i nga rgyal gyi shugs kyis: dgra bgegs byad ma dgug gzhug byas la bstim:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs nas: mdun gyi nam mkhar rta mgrin nag po la gnod sbyin nag po sde brgyad kyis bskor ba spyan drang: gtor ma 'bul: las rim bdun ma gyer: de nas rta mgrin nag po thugs khros nas: gtor ma nad mug mtshon gsum phung por bsam: dgra phyogs su btang: gal che na zor du 'phang: gtor snod kha sbubs la rta bro brdung: mi dmigs par rgyas gdab par bya'o: dpal rta mgrin nag po'i las rim bdun pa/ mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyis bsam yas mchims phu'i tshogs khang dbus ka ba mkha' 'gro'i gter mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'o// //
